summary.text: Bill Rhiley is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 80 who has served since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former newspaper publisher and teacher from Wellington, Kansas, he faces independent Lex Goff in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Bill Rhiley lives in Wellington, Kansas, and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration and business education and a master's degree in special education.
His career experience includes working as a publisher with the Belle Plaine News and Oxford Register newspapers and teaching business, computer and special education classes.
He has served on the Wellington Chamber of Commerce board of directors and has been a member of the Belle Plaine, Oxford and Arkansas City chambers of commerce.
Rhiley assumed office in the Kansas House in 2019.
